{{Top|leg}}
The '''Docking Club''' was a chain of [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]]. There was one present on every level of [[Byblos Starport Tower 214]]. The interiors were dark and smoky with secluded tables and booths and supposed to give the feel of being a [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] dive.
